== Description ==

[[Jacy Smith]] (right, full dark beard, dark graphic tee, name tag, holding a die), [[Randy Scott]] (left, Colorado Avalanche cap, glasses, light blue tee, in profile), [[Chris Wirfs]] (back left, floral shirt, shaking hands), and [[Nathan Russell]] (back right, black Star Wars T-shirt, glasses) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
